## Core Equipment Catalog

### 1. Industrial Rotary Dryers & Thermal Systems
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/
- Configurations: Single-pass direct heat, concentric double-pass return drum, and triple-pass high-efficiency dryers.
- Throughput Capacity: 500 kg/hr to 50 TPH continuous duty.
- Metallurgy & Standards: Certified IS 2062 Grade B structural carbon steel (12mm to 25mm plate shell), optional SS 304 / SS 316 corrosive liners, Hardox 400 wear plates.
- Drive & Mechanics: Forged EN-8 / EN-9 alloy steel trunnion rollers induction hardened to 280-320 BHN, 42CrMo4 girth gear, Siemens/ABB IE3 energy-efficient motors.
- Applications: Silica sand, foundry sand, bauxite, river sand, bentonite, coal, sawdust, biomass, and chemical powders.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Triple Pass Rotary Drum Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/triple-pass-dryer/ (Model MS-TPD-1500 / MS-TPD-3000, 3 to 30 TPH, 30% to 40% thermal fuel savings)
  - Industrial Rotary Sand Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/sand-dryer/ (Model MS-RSD-1200 / MS-RSD-2400, 5 to 45 TPH, discharge moisture below 0.5%)
  - Stainless Chemical Powder Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/chemical-powder-dryer/ (Model MS-CPD-1000 / MS-CPD-2000, SS 304/SS 316 contact parts, zero cross-contamination)
  - Biomass & Sawdust Rotary Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/biomass-sawdust-dryer/ (Model MS-BSD-1500 / MS-BSD-2800, 1 to 12 TPH, spark arrestor and explosion relief vents)

### 2. Sand Washing Plants & Hydrocyclone Separators
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/
- Configurations: Bucket wheel sand washers, high-pressure hydrocyclone desliming circuits, spiral screw sand classifiers, and high-frequency dewatering screens.
- Throughput Capacity: 30 TPH to 200 TPH.
- Silt Separation: Fines recovery down to 75 microns (200 mesh) with 12% to 15% moisture discharge.
- Resource Conservation: Integrated thickener and water recirculation delivering 75% to 80% water recovery.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Silica Sand Washing Plant: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/silica-sand-washing-plant/ (Model MS-SWP-50 / MS-SWP-200, 30 to 200 TPH, silt content reduction below 0.5%)
  - Bucket Wheel Sand Washing Machine: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/bucket-wheel-sand-washer/ (Model MS-BWW-2600 / MS-BWW-3600, 40 to 180 TPH, wear-resistant polyurethane screen panels)
  - Hydrocyclone Fine Sand Recovery Unit: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/hydrocyclone-sand-separator/ (Model MS-FSR-60 / MS-FSR-120, 60 to 120 m³/hr slurry, 95%+ recovery of 75-150 micron fines)
  - Heavy Mineral Log Washer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/mineral-log-washer/ (Model MS-LW-1000 / MS-LW-2000, 30 to 150 TPH, twin-shaft Hi-Cr paddles for tough plastic clay scrubbing)

### 3. Fertilizer Granulation & Pellet Plants
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/
- Configurations: Disc pan granulators with stepless tilt angle (40° to 55°), rotary drum granulators, rotary coolers, and rotary anti-caking coating drums.
- Throughput Capacity: 1 TPH to 20 TPH turnkey lines.
- Yield & Sizing: 2.0 mm to 4.5 mm spherical granule yield above 92%.
- Applications: Bio-organic compost, vermicompost, NPK chemical fertilizers, DAP compounds, and city compost.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Industrial Pan Disc Fertilizer Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/disc-granulator/ (Model MS-PG-2200 / MS-PG-3600, 1 to 8 TPH, 40° to 55° adjustable angle, 93%+ round pellets)
  - Double Roller Compaction Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/double-roller-granulator/ (Model MS-DRG-1000 / MS-DRG-3000, 1 to 5 TPH, room-temperature dry granulation, zero fuel)
  - Industrial Rotary Drum Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/rotary-drum-granulator/ (Model MS-RDG-1500 / MS-RDG-2500, 3 to 20 TPH, continuous tumbling agglomeration, UHMWPE liner)
  - Fertilizer Cooling & Anti-Caking Coating Drum: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/fertilizer-cooling-coating-drum/ (Model MS-CCD-1200 / MS-CCD-2200, dual-stage cooling and micronized oil coating)

- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/
